submission.justification:
Absorber-F2 at 6 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.115% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations, meeting the primary design goal. Comprehensive thickness optimization scans (2-10 mm range) for both F2 and F1 confirmed that 6 mm represents the optimal thickness for F2, showing a clear minimum in the resolution curve. This configuration outperforms Absorber-F1 by 19% (F1 optimal: 3.844% at 5 mm) and Absorber-F3 by 39% (F3: 5.08% at 5 mm). The optimization reveals the expected physical behavior: thinner plates suffer from sampling fluctuations while thicker plates degrade resolution due to reduced sampling frequency. The 6 mm thickness represents the optimal balance of these competing effects for F2.

CRITICAL LIMITATION: The hard safety constraint requiring residual dose rate ≤20 µSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown could not be verified, as NO dose rate data was found in any of the six project documents reviewed. This recommendation is therefore contingent upon subsequent verification that Absorber-F2 meets the dose rate requirement. If F2 fails dose rate verification, Absorber-F1 at 5 mm (3.844% resolution) should be implemented as the backup option, also subject to dose rate compliance verification.
